CREATE TABLE invoice (
      id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT NOT NULL,
      amount DOUBLE PRECISION DEFAULT NULL,
      name VARCHAR(100) DEFAULT NULL
  )

SELECT sum(amount), name
    from invoice
  group by name
  having (select v > 6 from (select sum(amount) v) t)
